title: CodeSocks configuration
description: Configure your provider routes in codesocks.jsonc. Comments and trailing commas are allowed. Invalid syntax and unknown fields stop loading.

$schema.description: Optional schema path or URL for your editor. It doesn't change routing.

enabled.description: Set false to disable CodeSocks. No requests go through its proxies.

proxies.description: Name your proxies here. Use {env:NAME} for credentials; keep proxy URLs out of logs.

additionalProperties.description: Proxy URL using http, https, socks4, socks4a, socks5, or socks5h. No path, query, or fragment.

providers.description: Choose a proxy and allowed origins for each provider ID.

rotation.description: Provider-local failover for transport errors and proxy authentication (407), with optional HTTP 429 rotation. Never replays the failed request or bypasses proxies.

enabled.description: Enable failover for subsequent requests, including OpenCode retries.

proxies.description: Ordered fallback proxy names. Must exist in proxies and differ from the primary proxy.

cooldownMs.description: Exclude a failed proxy for this many milliseconds. An exhausted pool returns 503.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive transport failures before rotating. Complete non-429 responses and manual selections reset the counter. Default 1 preserves existing behavior.

rotateOnRateLimit.description: Opt in to rotating after HTTP 429, independently of failureThreshold. Excludes the selected proxy for at least cooldownMs and Retry-After, but retains provider-wide Retry-After backoff. Never replays requests.

allowedOrigins.description: Required list of exact HTTP or HTTPS origins. No credentials or path beyond a root slash.

maxConcurrent.description: Cap in-flight requests per provider, including active streams. Default: 2.

minIntervalMs.description: Space request starts by at least this many milliseconds. Default: 0.

timeoutMs.description: Stop an upstream request after this many milliseconds. Default: 120000.

maxQueueWaitMs.description: Stop waiting for a provider slot after this many milliseconds. Default: 120000.
